---
title: "Defence spending"
description: "Government spending on defence, per person and as a share of all spending, compared with the EU."
---

Ireland spends less on defence per person than any other EU country. In 2024, government spending on defence came to €157 per person, compared with €592 across the EU.

{{< chart defence-spending-eu >}}

Measured against the size of the economy, spending was 0.1% of GDP, compared with 1.5% across the EU. Ireland's GDP is strongly affected by the activities of large multinational companies, as explained on the [Size of the economy](../economy/size.qmd) page, so per person figures and shares of government spending give a fairer comparison.

## Share of government spending

Defence made up 0.7% of all government spending in Ireland in 2024, compared with 3.0% across the EU. In 1995 the share in Ireland was 2.1%.

{{< chart defence-spending-share >}}

## Spending over time

In cash terms, defence spending was €841 million in 2024, compared with €444 million in 1995. These figures are not adjusted for inflation.

{{< chart defence-spending-trend >}}
